'''N5-R3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it was stationed at the [[Outpost Talarn]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TOR" />
